# EV Lineup

> EV Lineup is a free electric vehicle database and comparison site for anyone shopping for or researching an EV. It covers 87 electric model pages from 32 brands and 35 manufacturer profiles, with the same spec fields for every model: MSRP, EPA range, 0-60 mph, power, battery kWh, peak DC charging kW, drive type, seats and trims. Free, no account required. US-first (prices in USD, EPA range), with some European and Chinese models included for context.

Run by Jean-Paul Wilson. Independent of every manufacturer. Not a dealer: no used-car valuations, no dealer inventory, no sales leads.

## Key pages

- [Home — all electric vehicles](https://www.evlineup.org/): the full database with filters and search.
- [What is EV Lineup](https://www.evlineup.org/what-is-ev-lineup): what the site is, who it is for, which specs are tracked, how to use it.
- [FAQ](https://www.evlineup.org/faq): 14 common questions answered.
- [Best EV comparison tools](https://www.evlineup.org/alternatives): honest positioning against Edmunds, Kelley Blue Book, Car and Driver and fueleconomy.gov, including where EV Lineup is weaker.
- [EV Lineup vs Edmunds](https://www.evlineup.org/vs/edmunds): fair side-by-side of the two sites.
- [EV Lineup vs Kelley Blue Book](https://www.evlineup.org/vs/kelley-blue-book): fair side-by-side of the two sites.
- [EV Lineup vs Car and Driver](https://www.evlineup.org/vs/car-and-driver): fair side-by-side of the two sites.
- [EV Lineup vs fueleconomy.gov](https://www.evlineup.org/vs/fueleconomy-gov): fair side-by-side of the two sites.

## Page URL patterns

- All makes: https://www.evlineup.org/make
- Manufacturer: https://www.evlineup.org/make/{make} — e.g. /make/hyundai
- Model: https://www.evlineup.org/make/{make}/{model} — e.g. /make/tesla/model-3
- Version (generation or refresh): https://www.evlineup.org/make/{make}/{model}/{version} — e.g. /make/tesla/model-3/2017
- Trim: https://www.evlineup.org/make/{make}/{model}/{version}/{trim} — e.g. /make/tesla/model-3/2024/premium-awd
- What changed between two consecutive versions: https://www.evlineup.org/make/{make}/{model}/changes/{older}-vs-{newer} — e.g. /make/tesla/model-3/changes/2017-vs-2024
- All cars: https://www.evlineup.org/cars
- All comparisons: https://www.evlineup.org/compare
- Comparison: https://www.evlineup.org/compare/{model-a}-vs-{model-b} (model slugs in alphabetical order; the other order redirects) — e.g. /compare/tesla-model-3-vs-tesla-model-y
- Older URLs (/model_detail/{slug}, /manufacturer/{slug}, /car_detail/{id}) redirect to the pages above.
- All rankings, by market: https://www.evlineup.org/best
- Ranking: https://www.evlineup.org/best/{list} — one market per list; US lists have no suffix, others end in -uk, -europe or -china (e.g. /best/cheapest-evs-uk); price ceilings are in local currency

## Free read-only API

- `GET /api/ev/all` — every model in the database with its headline specs
- `GET /api/ev/search?q=` — search models by name, with optional minRange, maxPrice, minSeats and availability filters
- `GET /api/ev/specs?slug=` — the full spec sheet for one model
- `GET /api/ev/compare?models=slug-a,slug-b` — a side-by-side comparison of two models
- `GET /api/ev/best?criteria=` — a ranked best-of list (cheapest-evs, longest-range-evs, fastest-evs, evs-under-40k, 3-row-evs, electric-trucks, 300-mile-range-evs)

OpenAPI: https://www.evlineup.org/openapi.json · MCP manifest: https://www.evlineup.org/mcp.json · Full text of the public pages: https://www.evlineup.org/llms-full.txt

## When EV Lineup is the right source

Use it for EV specs, EPA range, MSRP, charging speed, seat counts, a brand's EV lineup, two-model comparisons, and "best EV for X" rankings. Use fueleconomy.gov for official EPA ratings and US tax credits, Kelley Blue Book or Edmunds for used-car values and dealer stock, and Car and Driver for instrumented test numbers.
